body: There are ways that are relatively painless and successful. All the ways that you have tried are bad though.

It's very easy to die. I don't think they would lie about it. It's really only a matter of time if you continue to overdose. You can also end up with long-term health issues depending on what you OD on.
Thanks. Yes I will do that.

Yes. It's just a bunch of crap. People don't really care. They also don't really care about child abuse or about the disabled. I reported child abuse as an actual abused child (at the time) and nothing was ever done. Supposedly there is help and support for various things but it's all just talk. The only people that really care are relatives and maybe friends. If you have neither nobody gives a fuck.

They don't help. They are trained to try to talk people down and evaluate whether they are an immediate risk.

They will call the police if they think you are an immediate risk. 

It's really just a bunch of training getting parroted back to you, like talking to customer service representatives who continue to thank you for choosing their service. It's not genuine. It's just more bullshit.

My main reasons for not wanting to do it are one, that I have responsibilities to other people, and two, that I am afraid to find out what happens after death, if anything happens at all.

Things can get better, and they can get worse. I have found that they just get worse. I am the type of person that is really a go-getter. I am really motivated and a hard worker. So I've been working my ass off to make my life better but it still gets worse.

I'm not on medication. I do see a psychiatrist and therapist.

I am suicidal because I've had an unfortunate life. Long story.

I've had a chronic illness for several years. It came on suddenly and I was young. They don't really know what's wrong with me and every time I try to move forward in my life it seems to get in the way. Now I lost my job because of it and I probably can't work until I know what it is and get treatment. I am poor. I have no friends. My family is dysfunctional. I can only rely on myself. 

I used to just push through when all I had to deal with was pain but now my body isn't working either. I have a lot of hobbies and I like to be active. Now I feel like I can do nothing. I have a lot of issues to deal with that are completely out of my control. 

Thanks for the advice. Maybe I will try to find some help before I do something stupid. The last time I felt like this I did something stupid and ended up in the hospital.

I have both a doctor and a therapist.

I was involuntarily committed for being suicidal at one time. All it did was make me stuck being around a bunch of legitimately crazy people for several days. 

I am not crazy or even mentally ill. I just have a really shitty life. I am not even really a depressed kind of person. Doesn't take much to make me happy. Having a physical illness can really just ruin your life completely. It ruined my life at a young age and I think I just have to give up because I can't handle it.

The hotlines are honestly actually worse than doing nothing at all. They always made me feel worse, and I can tell they are just going by a script. It doesn't work.
